prompts.tamara: Create one WEDOO fighting-game character select portrait. Use case: stylized-concept, identity-preserving photo-to-pixel-art. Reference is a labeled contact sheet: first two panels show TARGET PERSON's face; third shows target's clothing/body sprite; last two are STYLE AND BUST FRAMING ONLY, never copy their identities. Match last two portraits' detailed 1990s 16-bit arcade pixel-art: crisp stepped dark outlines, visible pixel clusters, warm skin shading, restrained dithering, no smooth painting or 3D. Square transparent PNG, head and shoulders bust cropped at upper chest, gentle three-quarter view facing RIGHT, small top margin, shoulders filling width. Preserve target's recognizable face, age, physique, hair and clothing from sprite. Fully transparent background, no scenery, text, border, props or fists. TARGET TAMARA: middle-aged woman, long voluminous wavy brown hair with golden highlights, dark rectangular glasses, long face and nose as in photos, subtle friendly smile; black top with charcoal long open textured vest/scarf matching sprite. Hair falls over shoulders. Only Tamara in final.
